.. change::
    :tags: bug, postgresql
    :tickets: 1504

    Fixed bug where :meth:`.Operations.alter_column` against a PostgreSQL
    identity column would render an incomplete, invalid ``ALTER TABLE ... ALTER
    COLUMN`` statement with no clause at all when ``existing_server_default``
    was omitted, even if there were no existing server default.  Pull request
    courtesy Riti Grover.
